name: European long distance path E6: Nyborg - Svendborg
description_md:
The European long distance path E6 from Nyborg to Svendborg is a waymarked hiking route in DK with a distance of 60.5 km. It is part of the international waymarked hiking network and is signposted as E6.

The route features 615 m of ascent and 612 m of descent. It requires about 17 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule and has a difficulty of hard, derived from distance and ascent. The route passes Svendborg within 400 m, Vejstrup kirke within 400 m, and Thurø Church within 1300 m.
